name: hedley-enquiries
description: Hedley Ventures enquiry form backend and private admin dashboard (Cloudflare Workers + D1).

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply hedley-enquiries --local -c wrangler.admin.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply hedley-enquiries --remote -c wrangler.admin.toml
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply hedley-enquiries --remote -c wrangler.admin.toml && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.intake.toml && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.admin.toml
